name: belgium-data-desk
description: Find, check and preview Belgian open data from Statbel, the KBO enterprise register, regional agencies and cities, in Dutch, French or English, with the official source, licence and pitfalls for each answer. Get official answers too: Statbel population, income, inflation and unemployment; air quality at any Belgian address; flood risk and the subsurface (soil, geology, groundwater) at an address in Flanders.
